data.body:
*Last updated: 12 November 2026 · By the NM7 Team*

> **Quick answer:** To find jobs faster on NM7, build your resume first (free, from an old file, photos, a LinkedIn PDF or simple questions), run the free ATS scan and fix what it flags, then open the job board and filter by role, skill, city and experience. Each job shows your match score, so apply first to the jobs where you match best. Use Manual Apply for free, or Auto Apply if you want NM7 to apply for you each morning. Track every application from your dashboard.

## Why use NM7 to find a job?

The slowest part of a fresher job search is not finding listings. It is sending the same weak resume to a hundred jobs and hearing nothing back. NM7 is built to fix that order of work: resume first, then the jobs you actually match, then applying.

Three things make it faster:

- **Your resume is ATS-safe from the start**, so it gets read instead of filtered out.
- **Every job shows a match score**, so you stop guessing which jobs are worth your time.
- **Companies are checked before their jobs go live**, so you waste less time on fake listings.

## Step 1: Build your resume

Open the [NM7 resume builder](https://nm7.si/builder) and pick where you are starting from:

| You have | What to do | What NM7 does |
|---|---|---|
| An old resume | Upload the PDF or Word file | Sorts it into clean sections |
| Certificates or notes | Take photos of them | Reads them and fills in the details |
| A LinkedIn profile | Upload your LinkedIn profile PDF | Fills every section it can |
| Nothing yet | Answer simple questions | Builds the resume one section at a time |

If writing in English is hard, speak or type your details in Telugu, Hindi or any of 8 Indian languages. The summary writer turns them into a clear English summary you can pick from.

Choose one of the ATS-safe [templates](https://nm7.si/templates). They avoid tables, text boxes and graphics that applicant tracking systems struggle to read.

## Step 2: Run the free ATS scan

Before you apply anywhere, run the [free ATS scan](https://nm7.si/scan). It scores your resume and points out what to fix: missing sections, weak bullet points, keywords recruiters search for. It needs no sign-up.

Fix the top issues first. A resume that scores well here is far more likely to reach a human recruiter.

## Step 3: Search the job board

Open the [NM7 job board](https://nm7.si/jobs). It lists internships, fresher jobs and roles for 0–3 years of experience. Search by role, skill or company and filter by:

- city or remote work
- experience level
- salary

Searching and saving jobs are free.

## Step 4: Use your match score

Each job shows how well your resume fits it. Use the score to decide your order of work:

1. **High match:** apply today.
2. **Medium match:** check which skills or keywords the job asks for that your resume does not show. If you genuinely have them, add them, then apply.
3. **Low match:** skip it for now, or save it as a goal and learn the missing skills.

This is the single biggest time saver. Twenty well-matched applications beat a hundred random ones.

## Step 5: Apply, by hand or automatically

**Manual Apply (free):** open the job and apply on the company's site or through NM7, depending on the listing.

**Auto Apply (paid):** choose the jobs you want and NM7 applies for you each morning. If a job needs something unusual, NM7 asks you first instead of guessing, and moves on to the next job in the meantime.

Before you apply to any job, check the company page. Jobs on NM7 come from companies that NM7 checks first, and each listing shows the company's verified status.

## Step 6: Track and follow up

Your [dashboard](https://nm7.si/me) shows the jobs you saved and applied to, so you know what to follow up on. If you prefer a simpler view, the easy dashboard uses big buttons and plain words and shows your next step.

## Want more help?

If your resume needs more than small fixes, NM7 offers paid options:

- **Expert rewrite:** a verified professional from your field rewrites your resume. Experts pass a profile review and a test task, and every order is rated.
- **LinkedIn pack:** headline, About, experience and skills written from your own details.
- **Tailor pack:** tailored resume copies and cover letters for the jobs you match.
- **Interview pack:** practice questions with answers built from your resume, and feedback.

Current prices are on the [Pricing](https://nm7.si/pricing) page.

- [How to get a job referral in India](https://nm7.si/blog/how-to-get-a-job-referral-india)

## FAQ

### How do I find jobs on NM7?

Build your resume on NM7, run the free ATS scan, then search the job board by role, skill, company and city. Each job shows your match score, so apply first where you match best.

### Do I need a resume to use NM7?

No. You can build one on NM7 from photos of your certificates, a LinkedIn profile PDF, or by answering simple questions.

### Is applying for jobs on NM7 free?

Yes. Searching, saving, the match score and Manual Apply are free. Auto Apply, where NM7 applies for you each morning, is a paid option.

### What does the match score mean?

It shows how well your resume fits a specific job. A higher score means your resume already shows more of what the job asks for.

### Are the jobs on NM7 real?

NM7 checks every company before its jobs reach students, including the company email domain and its registration number. Still, never pay anyone for a job; see our guide on [how to spot fake job postings](https://nm7.si/blog/how-to-spot-fake-job-postings-india).

## Final thoughts

Resume first, match second, apply third. Do the first two well on NM7 and every application you send has a real chance.
